text: Princess Nanaka is being attacked by someone, and Hayatemaru\npicks up her screams with his special ninja-dog hearing!\nFollow Hayatemaru's lead to get to Princess Nanaka!
Intimidated by your presence, the servant oni intend to\nreunite with their boss who has captured Princess Nanaka!\nFollow them!
The one who has kidnapped Princess Nanaka and now faces\nHayatemaru is the Ghostfire Oni, a powerful and formidable\nenemy feared by the local ninjas! Defeat him!
